thread.title: Noteworthy Thursday Option Activity: AAPL, RJF, CBS

author: BNK Invest
title: Noteworthy Thursday Option Activity: AAPL, RJF, CBS
text:
Shutterstock photo Looking at options trading activity among components of the S&P 500 index, there is noteworthy activity today in Apple Inc (Symbol: AAPL), where a total volume of 591,494 contracts has been traded thus far today, a contract volume which is representative of approximately 59.1 million underlying shares (given that every 1 contract represents 100 underlying shares). That number works out to 216.6% of AAPL's average daily trading volume over the past month, of 27.3 million shares. Especially high volume was seen for the $227.50 strike call option expiring September 07, 2018 , with 35,104 contracts trading so far today, representing approximately 3.5 million underlying shares of AAPL. Below is a chart showing AAPL's trailing twelve month trading history, with the $227.50 strike highlighted in orange:
Raymond James Financial Inc (Symbol: RJF) saw options trading volume of 9,734 contracts, representing approximately 973,400 underlying shares or approximately 183.5% of RJF's average daily trading volume over the past month, of 530,475 shares. Particularly high volume was seen for the $90 strike put option expiring November 16, 2018 , with 4,703 contracts trading so far today, representing approximately 470,300 underlying shares of RJF. Below is a chart showing RJF's trailing twelve month trading history, with the $90 strike highlighted in orange:
And CBS Corp (Symbol: CBS) options are showing a volume of 16,114 contracts thus far today. That number of contracts represents approximately 1.6 million underlying shares, working out to a sizeable 82.9% of CBS's average daily trading volume over the past month, of 1.9 million shares. Particularly high volume was seen for the $55 strike call option expiring October 19, 2018 , with 2,310 contracts trading so far today, representing approximately 231,000 underlying shares of CBS.
